title: Extract and Document VB6 Business Rules
problem_statement: Critical banking business logic is embedded in VB6 form event handlers without documentation, creating risk during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Loss of critical business logic during modernization leading to functional regressions and compliance violations
suggested_approach: Use VB6 AST parsing to extract event handlers, create business rule catalog with test cases
success_criteria: All form event handlers documented with business rules
Test cases created for each business rule

title: Database Schema Discovery and Documentation
problem_statement: Database schema, connection strings, and data contracts are unknown, creating risk for data integrity during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, loss of referential integrity, and failed modernization due to unknown data dependencies
suggested_approach: Reverse engineer database schema from Data Environment, create data dictionary and migration scripts

title: Security Model Modernization
problem_statement: VB6 authentication and authorization model lacks modern security patterns and audit capabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Security vulnerabilities, compliance violations, and unauthorized access to banking functions
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/JWT authentication, role-based access control, and audit logging

title: VB6 to Web UI Component Mapping
problem_statement: 13 VB6 forms need systematic mapping to modern web components while preserving user experience and functionality
risk_if_unaddressed: Inconsistent user experience, missing functionality, and extended development timeline
suggested_approach: Create form-to-component mapping matrix, develop reusable component templates, implement progressive migration
success_criteria: All forms mapped to web components
